episodes.synopsis: Yuina meets a talking frog and becomes a witch apprentice. Now she must make flowers bloom in people's hearts.
episodes.title: What’s Wrong With the Status Quo?!

episodes.synopsis: Yuina decides to befriend Azu, who clearly hates her. The girls try and attract customers to the flower shop.
episodes.title: You’re as Cheap and Flimsy as Your Clothes

episodes.synopsis: Azu must confront her deepest insecurities after she lashes out at a customer for her appearance.
episodes.title: The Word 'Lazy,' Pronounced as 'Being Yourself'

episodes.synopsis: The girls find out there's a mapo thief in their midst. An old friend of Mai's shows up at the flower shop.
episodes.title: Go for a 70 Over a 100

episodes.synopsis: After exhausting most of their mapo, the Maebashi Witches are in danger of turning back into normal girls.
episodes.title: Is That 70% of 100%?

episodes.synopsis: Business at Dreamy Dreamy Flower is booming. However, Kyoka notices that Choco has been acting strangely.
episodes.title: Choco's Big, Round, Chocolate Cake

episodes.synopsis: Choco breaks character after a customer interrupts her party, and the other girls find themselves at a loss.
episodes.title: When Things Suck, It Sucks to Admit That They Suck

episodes.synopsis: Choco is absent from the shop and Yuina comes down with a fever as the Tanabata festival looms ever closer.
episodes.title: Kyoka-chan, You Sure Are Dumb

episodes.synopsis: Yuina wants to enjoy some classic summer staples before vacation ends, but she's met with reluctance from Azu.
episodes.title: The Maebashi Witches Are Far Evermore

episodes.synopsis: The Maebashi Witches must take back the flower shop or lose all memories of their time as witch apprentices.
episodes.title: I'll Never Forget Today, Even After I Forget

episodes.synopsis: Yuina takes a trip to Tokyo by herself, but she can't help but shake the feeling that something's wrong.
episodes.title: Have We Met Before?

episodes.synopsis: Yuina and the others have recovered the memories of their time together, but their decision shocks Eiko.
episodes.title: I Think I'm Done Being a Witch
